label: Data kept in geo
description: All data stays inside the customer's selected geographic region — no cross-geo egress under any circumstances.

label: Data kept in geo unless otherwise indicated by calling service
description: Default is in-geo, but the calling service can request cross-geo handling per request. Each instantiation must pick a concrete behavior.

label: Data kept in geo unless customer allows cross-geo calls
description: Data stays in-geo by default; the customer can explicitly opt in to cross-geo flows via a documented control. Specify the exact opt-in mechanism.

label: Data not kept in geo
description: Data is processed or stored without geographic constraints. Requires explicit privacy review for any non-public data.
